escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, a vast dark hangar at night, the native layout of a vertical full-screen Stories and Reels ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the UPPER 44% of the frame is the deep, evenly dark, navy-black matte ceiling of the hangar with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no pieces, no glow, no bokeh, no lamps and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 46% and 80% of the frame height. The LOWEST 20% of the frame is the near-black matte rubber top of a launch console right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, with no light and no reflection reaching it. THE MOMENT: Nexa stands slightly RIGHT of center, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 50% of the frame height, the console cutting her at the waist so the white plates of her suit end above it; she looks straight into the lens through her clear glasses with a calm, demanding half-smile, razor-thin focus on her eyes. Behind her, an immense slow tunnel of HUNDREDS of glowing pieces of creative work recedes in deep perspective toward a vanishing point at the height of her waist: vertical stories, square posts, banners, product shots and film frames, all different in format yet sharing one brand look of sweeping orange (#FF6500) forms on deep navy; the tunnel never rises above 46% of the frame height. With her raised LEFT hand, palm open at chest height, fully visible from shoulder to fingertips, she has pulled ONE single vertical story frame out of the tunnel; it hovers above her palm, razor sharp, glowing warm orange, the brightest thing in the frame. The Content Spark, copied EXACTLY from its reference and smaller than her head, is PERCHED ON HER RIGHT SHOULDER, one small hand on her shoulder plate, holding up its small card next to the pulled piece as if comparing it. LIGHT: the pulled piece is the only key light on her: hard, from the front left and slightly below, her glasses, raised hand and the white plates of her shoulder glow warm orange while the far side of her face falls into deep shadow; NO fill light. A low cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines her hair and shoulders. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, small silver earrings, NO watch, NO bracelet, NO ring. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened. Thin haze catches the glow of the tunnel only below 46%. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any other brand.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte rubber top of a launch console right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width of the lowest 20% of the frame, completely out of focus, non-reflective, with no light and no reflection reaching it

texto.muro: the deep, evenly dark, navy-black matte ceiling of the hangar with fine visible texture
